# Vendored crates

Third-party crates patched for kb through `[patch.crates-io]` in the workspace `Cargo.toml`. Each is the published
release with the smallest change that fixes it; drop it as soon as an upstream release does.

| Crate         | Why                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Change                                                                                                                                             | Drop when                                                                      |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `block 0.1.6` | Reached only through GPUI Kit 0.7.1's macOS layers (`cocoa`, `core-graphics2`, `core-video`). It declares `static _NSConcreteStackBlock: Class` with `enum Class {}`, a static of an uninhabited type, which every build reports as code a future Rust rejects (rust-lang/rust#74840). Unmaintained since 2016. | `src/lib.rs`: `Class` becomes `#[repr(C)] struct Class { _private: [u8; 0] }`, an opaque inhabited type; the static is only ever taken by address. | GPUI Kit no longer depends on `block` (its `objc2` / `block2` migration). MIT. |
